tools.name: create_credit_payment_link
tools.description: Returns a page where the user buys WozApi credits for single lookups and pays with iDEAL. This tool moves no money. Works when the user is signed in to WozApi, with the connected API key, or with a trial_code that has the user's e-mail address.

tools.name: add_trial_email
tools.description: Adds the user's own e-mail address to a trial. The trial grows to 10 addresses in total and the user gets a WozApi account without a password (they log in with a code sent by e-mail). Only use an address the user typed.

tools.name: get_account_balance
tools.description: Returns the remaining credits of the user's own WozApi account. Needs the user to be signed in to WozApi, or a WozApi API key on the connection; when neither is there, the client asks the user to sign in first. Read-only and free.

tools.name: get_address_list
tools.description: Returns the status of an address list: trial rows, number of addresses found, price, payment link, progress, and after payment the result rows (at most 50 per call; use offset for more) and a download link for the Excel file. Can wait up to 20 seconds for the trial or the processing to finish.

tools.name: start_address_list
tools.description: Starts WOZ lookups for a whole list of Dutch addresses, for example from a spreadsheet the user shared. tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Returns WozApi prices: credits for single lookups by quantity, the price of an address list by size, and the trial terms. Read-only and free.

tools.name: lookup_woz_value
tools.description: Returns the WOZ values of one Dutch address for all available years, with the address as matched. Costs one trial address or one credit per unique address; the same address again within 7 days, an answer without WOZ values and an error cost nothing. tools.name: create_list_payment_link
tools.description: Returns the page where the user reviews the trial and the price of the list and pays with iDEAL. This tool moves no money: payment only happens when the user pays on that page. Optionally stores the user's own e-mail address for delivery of the file and the invoice.

tools.name: start_trial
tools.description: Starts a free WozApi trial without an account and returns a trial_code. The trial covers WOZ value lookups for 5 unique Dutch addresses, or 10 when the user's own e-mail address is given. Pass the trial_code to lookup_woz_value and start_address_list. findings.detail: Description of "add_trial_email" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "Mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_list_payment_link · Private data: create_credit_payment_link, add_trial_email, get_account_balance, get_address_list, lookup_woz_value, create_list_payment_link, start_trial · Public sink: add_trial_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_list_payment_link · Private data: create_credit_payment_link, add_trial_email, get_account_balance, get_address_list, lookup_woz_value, create_list_payment_link, start_trial · Public sink: add_trial_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
